parties: Le Travenues Technology Limited (Ixigo); Freshbus Private Limited
headline: Le Travenues Technology Limited divests stake in Freshbus Private Limited, ceasing associate status
sum: Ixigo has sold its stake in Freshbus Private Limited, resulting in the cessation of Freshbus as an associate company under IAS 28 and Regulation 30 disclosure norms.
implication: Divestment of non-core travel tech associate signals portfolio rationalisation; review exit valuation under Schedule VI (fair value) and equity accounting reversal impact on consolidated financials.
detail: Le Travenues Technology Limited (listed on NSE as IXIGO), a travel technology platform, has divested its shareholding in Freshbus Private Limited, a bus aggregation / transportation tech venture. The divestment results in cessation of associate company classification. The announcement was made under Regulation 30 (material events/transactions) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR), 2015. No transaction value or buyer identity disclosed in the NSE filing.

framework.ref: SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR), 2015 - Regulation 30
framework.note: Material events: divestment of associates; mandatory disclosure within 30 minutes of board decision or as soon as practicable.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 - Section 2(6) and Schedule VI
framework.note: Definition of associate; fair value measurement and disclosure of investments; equity accounting reversal on deconsolidation.

framework.ref: Indian Accounting Standard (IAS) 28 - Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures
framework.note: Accounting treatment for ceasing associate status; reversal of equity-accounted carrying value; gain/loss on disposal.

framework.ref: SEBI Master Circular on Related Party Transactions (if applicable)
framework.note: If buyer is related party, RPT disclosure and audit committee approval required.
Tax treatment of gain/loss on divestment of associate stake; long-term vs. short-term capital gains.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), 1999 - if foreign investor exit
framework.note: Repatriation of sale proceeds if overseas buyer; RBI approval if applicable.

conditions: Cessation of Freshbus as associate company of Le Travenues
approvals: Board approval by Ixigo (implied by Regulation 30 filing)
structure.novel: No novel structure; straightforward divestment of minority stake in private travel-tech associate.

triggers.note: Divestment of associate company is a material event requiring immediate disclosure.
Fair value measurement and disclosure of investment write-off or gain on sale.
Equity accounting reversal and treatment of post-deconsolidation gain/loss in P&L.
